summary: The self-contained v27 design closes the v26 findings without normative inheritance: it freezes exact policy identities and dates, per-table availability-projected PIT payloads and nullable-status behavior, the complete prepared directory transaction and executable cleanup permissions, immutable one-run authority generations, an actual-worker-held execution lease with predecessor outcomes, safely retryable read-only replay attempts, and current M7 v5 with full fixed/behavior qualification predicates, complete CCC math and a capability-scoped checkpoint loader. It remains design-only and authorizes no implementation, replay, M7 fit, budget change or final-OOS.
